title: Randomized decision tree average cost
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized decision tree on $n$ coordinates with input alphabet $\Omega$ and output alphabet $\alpha$, and let $\mu$ be a probability distribution on the finite input space $(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)$. Define the average cost of $T$ under $\mu$ as the expectation, over inputs drawn from $\mu$, of its input cost.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a randomized decision tree with input alphabet $\Omega$, output alphabet $\alpha$, and a function it computes
the input space $(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)$ is finite
$\mu$ is a probability distribution on that input space
